headline: Four-alarm fire in Rockport displaces families and businesses
dek: Firefighters knocked down a blaze at a mixed-use building on Broadway after a gas odor was reported Sunday morning. No injuries were reported, and the cause is under investigation.
body: A four-alarm fire at a mixed-use building on Broadway in Rockport displaced at least two families and commercial businesses Sunday, according to the Rockport Police and Fire Departments.

Firefighters responded to 19 Broadway Avenue at about 9:58 a.m. after a report of a strong gas odor throughout the building. Crews found thick black smoke and an active fire, then requested additional manpower and mutual aid from departments across the North Shore.
Crews knocked down the fire at about 1 p.m., the departments said. No injuries were reported. National Grid shut off electrical service while firefighters and investigators worked at the scene.
The Rockport Fire Department and the Massachusetts State Police Fire and Explosion Investigation Unit are investigating the cause.
